job.value: compare listings for what they searched

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: Query 'iphone 11', '1000+ results in Singapore' and the listing grid make it a results page.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: Listings lead, but the red '+ Sell' button is the most saturated element on a buyer's results page.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'All categories' and 'Filters' are clear, but the 'Delivery' chip's shield icon and the bookmark in the search field don't say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: The purple square badge before two titles has no label, so its meaning isn't clear.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Cards show only the comparison facts (price, condition, seller).

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The '+ Sell' button and the 'Leave the cleaning to the pros' ad aren't for a buyer comparing iPhones.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Prices, condition and tags carry it without prose.

dimensions.name: focus
dimensions.why: §1.5 — the red 'Sell' button is the only filled action; §1.2 — the first screen is the query, filters and results. The 'Leave the cleaning' ad below the fourth card is the one block unrelated to 'iphone 11'.

dimensions.name: density
dimensions.why: §2 browsing — four listings fully visible in two columns, each with photo, price, original price, condition and seller: the facts buyers compare on.

dimensions.name: hierarchy
dimensions.why: §1.6 — photo, then bold title, then price, then grey meta reads as a clear ladder per card; the 'Certified' and 'Buyer Protection' tags sit in different spots on the photo (top vs bottom edge), a small break in §1.8.

dimensions.name: clarity
dimensions.why: §1.13 — the screen explains itself: query in the field, '1000+ results in Singapore'. The purple square before two titles has no label, so its meaning (Spotlight) isn't obvious (§3 a label says why).
